column1: # Lane L2 ledger (docs/plans/2026-11-22-dm0b-scc-cut.md section 5, row L2 "mailbox").
# One row per declaration of every file this lane touched at HEAD. Columns:
#   record row_id source_file kind symbol source_line target_file target_symbol
# hit = sha256_16 of the whitespace-normalised HEAD body after the rename map below;
# line_end = last line of the declaration in target_file today.
#   moved         the body left the root unchanged modulo the rename map
#   moved_adapter the body left the root AND a thin root adapter keeps the old
#                 name for one caller that cannot take the new import
#   present       untouched in place (the 4 root test files' 22 test functions are
#                 all present: no test file moved in this lane)
# Verifier: .rush/tmp/sprint0/l2/oracle.py (scratch, not checked in). With this
# ledger it reports rows=126, failures=0, pass=true. It fails on a flipped hit, on a
# wrong source_line, on a dropped rename-map entry and on a moved row relabelled
# present (all four exercised by mutation on scratch copies); adapter rows are
# validated by shape, not by name (one statement, call of a package-qualified or
# package-local function whose arguments are parameters, <= 40 tokens; or a single
# Normalisation also strips the "mailbox." and "mailboxpkg." qualifiers: the root
# package keeps its own mailbox type, so every root file imports the new package as
# "mailboxpkg" (an unaliased import named mailbox collides with that type).
# Scope: 14 files -- the 4 root files that lost a declaration (queued_call_resolution.go
# is deleted whole; mailbox_queue.go, mailbox_ownership.go and queued_call_scope.go
# keep theirs), the 3 new internal/agent/runtime/exec/mailbox files, the 2 root files
# whose bodies gained the mailboxpkg qualifier (mailbox_interrupt.go,
# agent_ownership.go) and the 4 root test files that call the moved names.
# The two root adapters, with their anchored reason: internal/agent/agent_run.go is
# ratcheted at 919 lines in .githooks/file_size_900_allowlist.txt and a listed file
# may not grow, so it cannot take the import the two names it calls would need.
# deferReleaseRetainedRunScope (one-line delegate) and turnEndRelease (a var, so a
# test can wrap the release site and count that it fired) therefore stay in
# queued_call_scope.go, which this lane shortened by 74 lines.
# Remainder, NOT moved by this lane and why:
#   - the mailbox state machine (mailbox.go, mailbox_generation.go, mailbox_inject.go,
#     declarations + 23 struct fields, incl. every "func (mb *mailbox)" method) stays
#     in the root: 24+ root test files
#     read its unexported fields (state, epoch, submitted, replacement, injects,
#     current, currentCall, stopped, the four test seams) and lock mb.mu directly, and
#     &mailbox{state: mbOwned, current: generation{...}} literals cannot be written
#     across a package boundary without exporting the fields and the mutex;
#     it names *sessionAgent, DiskProviderRegistry, diskOwnerKey, batchIngressTool and
# A later pass needs DM7's C1 port (so leaf code stops naming *coordinator and
